objective: Prove B1 and the one-atom part of B3; compute the host census and the learner's paths by level on the declared spaces (B2-B4).
status: Proved 2026-11-10 (theorem 1 by hand; the rest computed; pre-registered): at genus 2 the floor unit is one over-agreeing face that no learning step can move. Computed on K_2 and K_3 with one or two atoms: the dissonance moves down into an atom by growth at the dissonance and is resolved there, or leaves one unit inside the other atom, present since that atom was grown; with atoms away the sight-4 learner is stuck; upper faces can hold the floor unit on half the spaces, atoms on all. B2 and parts of B3 and B4 failed as pre-registered.
title: Where a dissonance sits among atoms
